```{r}
library(shiny)
library(mapview)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library (leaflet)
```

```{r}
gpkg_path <- here("data", "county_data.gpkg")

st_layers(gpkg_path)          # see layer names
counties <- st_read(gpkg_path, layer = "county_data")  # or whatever layer name appears

names(counties)               # see column names
unique(counties$SOME_COLUMN)  # inspect a candidate column for the dropdown
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
gpkg_path <- here("data", "county_data.gpkg")

# See what layers are in the .gpkg
st_layers(gpkg_path)

# Read the main layer (replace "counties" with the actual layer name if different)
counties <- st_read(gpkg_path, layer = "county_data", quiet = TRUE)
```


```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("County Language Map"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput(
        "var",
        "Choose category",
        choices = sort(unique(counties[[filter_col]]))
      )
    ),
    mainPanel(
      leafletOutput("map", height = "700px")
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    req(filter_col %in% names(counties))
    
    filtered_data <- counties[counties[[filter_col]] == input$var, ]
    
    mapview(
      filtered_data,
      zcol = filter_col,
      layer.name = filter_col
    )@map
  })
}
```

```{r}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```

- The dataframe should have everything you need, no need for new calculations/columns
